# Bergen Car Company

> Family-owned used car dealership at 22 US 46 East, Lodi, New Jersey 07644. Operating since 2008. Specializes in work vans, police cars, and handicap-accessible vehicles, and also sells pre-owned sedans, SUVs, trucks, and the rest of a general used-car lot. Up-front pricing (no dealer prep or add-on fees beyond NJ tax, title, registration, and a $499 documentary fee), arranges financing for all credit situations, and buys cars and takes trade-ins with written same-day offers. Does not operate a repair shop. Phone: (973) 928-6300. Showroom hours: Mon–Fri 9–8, Sat 9–6, Sun 11–4.

## Key facts

- Location: 22 US 46 East, Lodi, NJ 07644 (Bergen County)
- Every vehicle includes a 3-month / 3,000-mile limited powertrain warranty; extended service contracts optional
- Vehicle history reports available on request; independent mechanic inspections encouraged before purchase
- Financing uses a soft credit pull for pre-qualification (no score impact, no SSN required to start)
- Trade-in and outright-purchase offers are written, same-day, and shown with the underlying math
- No countdown timers or manufactured scarcity on the specials page
- Serves ~54 towns across Bergen, Passaic, Hudson, Essex, and Morris counties in NJ plus Rockland County, NY

- [Financing](https://bergencarcompany.com/financing): pre-qualification form, payment estimator, and how credit checks work
- [Value your trade-in](https://bergencarcompany.com/trade): trade-in estimate form and how the offer is calculated
- [Sell your car](https://bergencarcompany.com/sell): sell a car outright with no purchase required
- [Schedule a test drive](https://bergencarcompany.com/test-drive): book a specific car and time
- [Warranty coverage](https://bergencarcompany.com/warranty): what the included warranty covers, extended options, FTC Buyers Guide explained
- [Reviews](https://bergencarcompany.com/reviews): customer reviews with owner responses
- [About](https://bergencarcompany.com/about): company history and team
- [Contact](https://bergencarcompany.com/contact): phone, text, email, map and hours
- [Service areas](https://bergencarcompany.com/service-areas): hub linking every town-specific page
- [Blog](https://bergencarcompany.com/blog): guides on used-car buying, financing, and maintenance
